shortDescription: Signs a certificate signing request as an intermediate CA in HashiCorp Vault

options.name: alt_names
options.description: The list of Subject Alternative Names (SANs) to include in the intermediate CA. Each element should be a hostname (DNS name) or an email address. If this does not include the common name and O(exclude_cn_from_sans=false), the common name will be added to the list of SANs. If not provided, an empty list will be used.

options.name: auth_method
options.description: Authentication method to be used. C(none) auth method was added in collection version C(1.2.0). C(cert) auth method was added in collection version C(1.4.0). C(aws_iam_login) was renamed C(aws_iam) in collection version C(2.1.0) and was removed in C(3.0.0). C(azure) auth method was added in collection version C(3.2.0).

options.name: aws_access_key
options.description: The AWS access key to use.

options.name: aws_iam_server_id
options.description: If specified, sets the value to use for the C(X-Vault-AWS-IAM-Server-ID) header as part of C(GetCallerIdentity) request.

options.name: aws_profile
options.description: The AWS profile

options.name: aws_secret_key
options.description: The AWS secret key that corresponds to the access key.

options.name: aws_security_token
options.description: The AWS security token if using temporary access and secret keys.

options.name: azure_client_id
options.description: The client ID (also known as application ID) of the Azure AD service principal or managed identity. Should be a UUID. If not specified, will use the system assigned managed identity.

options.name: azure_client_secret
options.description: The client secret of the Azure AD service principal.

options.name: azure_resource
options.description: The resource URL for the application registered in Azure Active Directory. Usually should not be changed from the default.

options.name: azure_tenant_id
options.description: The Azure Active Directory Tenant ID (also known as the Directory ID) of the service principal. Should be a UUID. Required when using a service principal to authenticate to Vault, e.g. required when both I(azure_client_id) and I(azure_client_secret) are specified. Optional when using managed identity to authenticate to Vault.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: Path to certificate to use for authentication. If not specified by any other means, the C(VAULT_CACERT) environment variable will be used.

options.name: cert_auth_private_key
options.description: For C(cert) auth, path to the private key file to authenticate with, in PEM format.

options.name: cert_auth_public_key
options.description: For C(cert) auth, path to the certificate file to authenticate with, in PEM format.

options.name: common_name
options.description: The requested common name (CN) attribute for the intermediate CA.

options.name: country
options.description: The Country (C) values to include in the CA certificate. If not provided, this defaults to an empty list on new roles.

options.name: csr
options.description: The certificate signing request (CSR) to sign.

options.name: engine_mount_point
options.description: The path where the secret backend is mounted.

options.name: exclude_cn_from_sans
options.description: Whether to exclude the common name from the Subject Alternate Names (SANs). If set to V(true), the given O(common_name) will not be added to the list of SANs. If set to V(false), the given O(common_name) will be added to the list of SANs and parsed as a DNS name or email address. If not provided, the common name will not be excluded.

options.name: ext_key_usage
options.description: The extended key usage of the signed certificate. If not provided, no extended key usage will be included.

options.name: format
options.description: The format of the signed certificate.

options.name: ip_sans
options.description: The list of IP Subject Alternative Names (IP SANs) to include in the intermediate CA. Each element should be a valid IP address. If not provided, an empty list will be used.

options.name: jwt
options.description: The JSON Web Token (JWT) to use for JWT authentication to Vault.

options.name: key_usage
options.description: The key usage of the signed certificate. If not provided, Vault defaults to providing V(DigitalSignature), V(KeyEncipherment), and V(KeyAgreement) key usages.

options.name: locality
options.description: The Locality (L) values to include in the CA certificate. If not provided, this defaults to an empty list on new roles.

options.name: mount_point
options.description: Vault mount point. If not specified, the default mount point for a given auth method is used. Does not apply to token authentication.

options.name: namespace
options.description: Vault namespace where secrets reside. This option requires HVAC 0.7.0+ and Vault 0.11+. Optionally, this may be achieved by prefixing the authentication mount point and/or secret path with the namespace (e.g C(mynamespace/secret/mysecret)). If environment variable C(VAULT_NAMESPACE) is set, its value will be used last among all ways to specify I(namespace).

options.name: not_after
options.description: The latest date and time at which the signed certificate is valid. This value is a UTC timestamp in C(YYYY-MM-ddTHH:MM:SSZ) format. If not provided, this defaults to the C(not_after) value on the role.

options.name: organization
options.description: The Organization (O) values to include in the CA certificate. If not provided, this defaults to an empty list on new roles.

options.name: other_sans
options.description: The list of custom OID/UTF8-string SANs. If not provided, an empty list will be used.

options.name: ou
options.description: The Organizational Unit (OU) values to include in the CA certificate. If not provided, this defaults to an empty list on new roles.

options.name: password
options.description: Authentication password.

options.name: postal_code
options.description: The Postal Code values to include in the CA certificate. If not provided, this defaults to an empty list on new roles.

options.name: province
options.description: The Province or State (ST) values to include in the CA certificate. If not provided, this defaults to an empty list on new roles.

options.name: proxies
options.description: URL(s) to the proxies used to access the Vault service. It can be a string or a dict. If it's a dict, provide the scheme (eg. C(http) or C(https)) as the key, and the URL as the value. If it's a string, provide a single URL that will be used as the proxy for both C(http) and C(https) schemes. A string that can be interpreted as a dictionary will be converted to one (see examples). You can specify a different proxy for HTTP and HTTPS resources. If not specified, L(environment variables from the R

options.name: region
options.description: The AWS region for which to create the connection.

options.name: retries
options.description: Allows for retrying on errors, based on the L(Retry class in the urllib3 library,https://urllib3.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/urllib3.util.html#urllib3.util.Retry). This collection defines recommended defaults for retrying connections to Vault. This option can be specified as a positive number (integer) or dictionary. If this option is not specified or the number is C(0), then retries are disabled. A number sets the total number of retries, and uses collection defaults for the other settin

options.name: retry_action
options.description: Controls whether and how to show messages on I(retries). This has no effect if a request is not retried.

options.name: role_id
options.description: Vault Role ID or name. Used in C(approle), C(aws_iam), C(azure) and C(cert) auth methods. For C(cert) auth, if no I(role_id) is supplied, the default behavior is to try all certificate roles and return any one that matches. For C(azure) auth, I(role_id) is required.

options.name: secret_id
options.description: Secret ID to be used for Vault AppRole authentication.

options.name: serial_number
options.description: The serial number of the CA certificate. If you want more than one, specify alternative names in the alt_names map using OID 2.5.4.5. If not provided, HashiCorp Vault will generate a random serial number for the certificate.

options.name: signature_bits
options.description: The signature algorithm bit length for the signed certificates. Should only be provided when CSR has a private key using the RSA algorithm. If not provided, this defaults to the C(signature_bits) on the role.

options.name: street_address
options.description: The Street Address values to include in the CA certificate. If not provided, this defaults to an empty list on new roles.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Sets the connection timeout in seconds. If not set, then the C(hvac) library's default is used.

options.name: token
options.description: Vault token. Token may be specified explicitly, through the listed [env] vars, and also through the C(VAULT_TOKEN) env var. If no token is supplied, explicitly or through env, then the plugin will check for a token file, as determined by I(token_path) and I(token_file). The order of token loading (first found wins) is C(token param -> ansible var -> ANSIBLE_HASHI_VAULT_TOKEN -> VAULT_TOKEN -> token file).

options.name: token_file
options.description: If no token is specified, will try to read the token from this file in I(token_path).

options.name: token_path
options.description: If no token is specified, will try to read the I(token_file) from this path.

options.name: token_validate
options.description: For token auth, will perform a C(lookup-self) operation to determine the token's validity before using it. Disable if your token does not have the C(lookup-self) capability.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The expiration duration of the signed certificate. This value can be provided as a duration string, such as V(72h), or as an number of seconds. If not provided, this defaults to the C(default_lease_ttl) value of the role.

options.name: uri_sans
options.description: The list of URI Subject Alternative Names (URI SANs) to include in the intermediate CA. Each element should be a valid URI. If not provided, an empty list will be used.

options.name: url
options.description: URL to the Vault service. If not specified by any other means, the value of the C(VAULT_ADDR) environment variable will be used. If C(VAULT_ADDR) is also not defined then an error will be raised.

options.name: username
options.description: Authentication user name.

options.name: uss_pss
options.description: Whether to use the Probabilistic Signature Scheme (PSS) for RSA keys. Should only be provided when CSR has a private key using the RSA algorithm. If not provided, this defaults to the C(use_pss) on the role.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Controls verification and validation of SSL certificates, mostly you only want to turn off with self signed ones. Will be populated with the inverse of C(VAULT_SKIP_VERIFY) if that is set and I(validate_certs) is not explicitly provided. Will default to C(true) if neither I(validate_certs) or C(VAULT_SKIP_VERIFY) are set.
